description: Post-selection, same-data diagnostics evaluated at the narrowband discovery epoch, shape and signed response. Local one-sided p values are descriptive.
leverage_rule: At each site-day require 1 - rho^2 >= 0.01 for GLS columns 1 and (1400 MHz/f)^2; maximum permitted intercept variance inflation is 100. ECORR groups stay intact.
comparison: Both members of each raw/intercept pair use the identical participating set at each event, on identical site-days. Their residual degrees of freedom, red harmonic budgets and noise precision can differ. Amplitude changes alone do not identify a dispersive origin.
